description.text: Objective This objective is to train students to be technical personnel working, after graduation, in the fields of the development, design and maintenance of computer application software and network software.. Core courses Higher Mathematics, Digital Circuit, Software Engineering Foundation, Discrete Mathematics, Data Structure, Network Principle, Operation System, C Language Program Design, Database Principle, Soft Engineering, Software Testing and Maintenance, Face The Target And Design Program, Object-Oriented Programming, Object-Oriented Analysis and Design, Project Management, Java Program Design, Algorithm Designing and Analysis, Windows Program Design, Design of Assemble Program and Linux Program Design. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Engineering or Science is granted.

duration.text: The Software Engineering at Sichuan Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Certification of no criminal record 8.Copy of insurance policy 9.Photocopies of personal artwork Those who apply for artistic major should supply materials to prove your art level.

requirements.text: 1.High school graduates 2.No criminal record 3.HSK level 3 or above
